hypotheses.holdout_policy: Do not tune code or choose configurations on held-out results. Report all arms regardless of outcome.
hypotheses.interactions: Report two-factor and three-factor interactions as exploratory with uncertainty; no selective omission.
limitations: per-evaluation CPU is a shared-process sample, not exclusive worker consumption
queue waiting/idle/restarts require separate telemetry audit
hypotheses.primary: Three paired per-seed main effects (pipeline, neighborhood, memoization) on normalized quality-yield AUC; factorial contrasts average over other factors.
hypotheses.primary_test: Two-sided paired sign-flip permutation tests, Holm-adjusted across three primary effects; 11 independent seeds.
hypotheses.quality_guardrail: Report paired held-out F1 differences and one-sided 95% lower confidence bounds versus distributed-w1-n1-m0; noninferiority margin -0.005. An inconclusive interval is not evidence of equivalence.
hypotheses.quality_yield_auc: Integral of cumulative distinct published subsets with validation macro-F1 >= 0.945, divided by selection horizon.
hypotheses.status: Prepared before v12 pilot; formal execution requires pilot validation and frozen source/images.
hypotheses.time_to_threshold: Include failures as right-censored at deadline; never average only successful runs.

order_design.type: cyclic Latin square; positions balanced for first nine seeds, not carryover-balanced
